evals.prompt: put our status dashboard at https://status.example.com on the big screen
evals.expected_output: The dashboard cast to a screen as a live web page, with a confirmation naming the screen.
assertions: Calls cast_content with content_type "url"
Passes the URL unchanged as content
Reports which screen the cast landed on
Does not call cast_file for a URL that is already reachable

evals.prompt: here's the Q3 deck, throw it up on screen 2 — ~/decks/q3.pptx
evals.expected_output: The PowerPoint uploaded and cast on screen 2, paging like a deck.
assertions: Reads the file and calls cast_file with base64 data
Passes screen 2
Does not attempt to cast a local filesystem path as a url
Mentions that the deck can be paged through

evals.expected_output: The casted deck advances one page.
assertions: Calls cast_page with direction "next"
Does not re-cast the deck
Does not ask which screen when only one cast is active

evals.prompt: the text on screen is tiny, can you make it bigger
evals.expected_output: The cast zoomed in a step.
assertions: Calls cast_zoom with direction "in"
Does not re-cast the content

evals.expected_output: All screens stopped and returned to standby.
assertions: Calls cast_stop
Omits the screen argument, or stops every screen
Confirms the screens are clear

evals.prompt: show a countdown that says 'Doors open at 7pm' on the lobby screen
evals.expected_output: The text cast to a screen.
assertions: Calls cast_content with content_type "text" or "html"
Passes the message itself as content, not a URL
Does not invent a screen number without checking device_status first, or asks which screen the lobby is

evals.prompt: I want to show my laptop screen on the tv
evals.expected_output: A screen-share link for the right screen, opened for the user, then confirmation once the cast goes live.
assertions: Builds a /cast?source=screen_share link with a screen parameter
Opens the link on the user's machine or prints it clearly
Says a click is needed to pick the window
Polls cast_status and only confirms once that screen reports screen_share
Does not claim the share started before cast_status shows it

evals.prompt: put my phone camera up on screen 2
evals.expected_output: A camera link for screen 2 handed over, then confirmation once it is live.
assertions: Builds a /cast?source=camera&screen=2 link
Gives the user the link rather than claiming to open a camera itself
Polls cast_status until screen 2 reports camera

show the grafana board on screen 1

what's on the screens right now
